name: Camera-based deck activity monitor

source.document: Team-defined Logitech BRIO 101 + Snapdragon/Dragonwing Scenario D prototype: CPU OpenCV on Dell Snapdragon X Elite, with future Dragonwing transfer unverified; not an Annex B guest.
assumptions_added: All power, mass, placement, bandwidth, compute and installation values are Scenario D demonstration assumptions, not verified hardware figures.
Monitoring 0.040 kW and alerting 0.065 kW are illustrative system load reservations, not the BRIO 101's measured USB draw.
1.2 kg represents a hypothetical onboard camera and mounting enclosure, not the Dell laptop.
G7 is a ship-side perimeter camera simulation; live video is processed separately on the Dell workstation.
0.02 Mbit/s reserves detection metadata only; raw camera video is not transmitted on the simulated ship backbone.
One crew member and 30 minutes for port installation remain unverified demo assumptions.

capability.description: Watches a designated perimeter-surveillance region for unclassified motion candidates; publishes advisory signals to Scenario D, separate from flight-deck clearance.

configurations.notes: Hypothetical use of the one free mast slot; may compete with G1/G5. Physical mounting is not verified.

power_modes.notes: Scenario D monitoring: synthetic 0.040 kW continuous load.
Scenario D alert: synthetic 0.065 kW continuous load while an observation is active.

cooling.notes: Hypothetical mast air cooling; 1:1 electrical-to-heat convention.

data_links.notes: Scenario D metadata events only, 0.02 Mbps assumed; no raw video transmitted.

operational_modes.notes: Observes a perimeter region independent of G4's launch deck. No motion does not certify safety.
Unclassified motion alert; two positive observations are required by Scenario D before automated simulated G4 startup.

installation.notes: Hypothetical one-person 30-minute port-only install for solver demonstration; not a real installation certificate.

policy_hints: G7 is perimeter surveillance only; never infer independent flight-deck clearance.
Require two consecutive valid positive observations before simulated G4 power-up.
Camera loss or stale data is UNKNOWN; never substitute it for operator launch authorization.
Only automatically start a software simulation of G4 power-up; no hardware start/launch commands.
documented_unknowns: Actual electrical draw, environmental reliability, mass, mounting and end-to-end camera latency are unverified.
The motion detector has no object classifier, person identification or certified intrusion detection; an unclassified candidate is not an identified object.
Actual hardware interface for Qualcomm Dragonwing and physical drone commands are not implemented.
Flight-deck safety requires separate verified checks; perimeter detection cannot validate takeoff conditions.
notes: User-defined G7 with new Scenario D synthetic values; camera prototype runs on Dell Snapdragon X Elite.
Scenario D responds to motion, not a certified AI object classification; NPU deployment is optional future work.
All simulated launches require an independent deck verification and explicit software operator authorization.
